name: incident-triage-agent
description: AI agent for first-pass incident triage on microservices. Two LangGraph agents (investigator + reviewer) use 5 read-only tools, guardrails and human approval to find the root cause. Evaluated on RCAEval RE2, free models only.

paragraphs: An AI agent that does the first-pass investigation of a production alert in a microservice system. It pulls only the metrics, logs and traces it needs through 5 read-only tools, finds the matching runbook, and returns a root cause, the evidence behind it, and a proposed fix. A second "reviewer" agent tries to prove the diagnosis wrong. Risky actions wait for a human. The agent never executes anything.

Built with LangGraph (explicit StateGraph, interrupt(), SQLite checkpointer), Pydantic, SQLite, Chroma, MCP and free open-weight models. It is evaluated on 15 held-out failure cases from the RCAEval benchmark.
Live demo: incident-triage-agen.streamlit.app. Replay any test case with no API calls, or run one live with Scout on Groq and Skeptic on Gemma.

requirements.text: No free-tier API key was available when the eval ran, and Groq's free tier has a daily token cap far below what the full eval (dev and test, reviewer on and off) needs.
Why not a Hugging Face Space, as first planned: new Gradio Spaces on free CPU now need a PRO plan (the API returned 402), and the account's two free ZeroGPU slots were in use.
